name: Outlook OOO Auto Cancel & Decline | AI Intent-Protected

parameters.formTitle: Out of Office — Cancel & Decline Meetings (AI Intent-Protected)

values.fieldLabel: Reason (will be added to the cancellation/decline email)
values.placeholder: e.g. on vacation, sick leave, business trip

options.customCss: button[type="submit"]:disabled::after{content:"Do not close this window. Outlook Events are loading.";display:block;margin-top:12px;color:#c5221f;font-weight:600;font-size:0.9rem;}

messageValues.message:
You decide whether a calendar event should be protected from cancellation/decline while the user is out of office, based only on its intent. Return json with keys protected (boolean), label, confidence (0..1) and reason.

Protect (protected=true) ONLY when there is a CLEAR signal for one of these intents:
- "active_contribution": the user must actively contribute — they present, chair, decide, or are the sole knowledge holder. This INCLUDES a small meeting the user organized with only one or two other people (e.g. a 1:1 with a manager) where the user clearly drives the discussion.
- "relationship_career": the meeting is relationship- or career-critical — a 1:1 with a manager, a client meeting, a review or an interview — where cancelling would carry real social or professional cost.
- "stay_informed": a large all-hands / town hall / company update where the user is one of many attendees but the content is important to stay informed on.
When none of these clearly applies, return protected=false and label "none".

You only have the subject, the organizer flag, the number of other attendees and the recurrence flag. You do NOT have attendee roles, names or relationships. Do NOT invent relationships (such as "manager" or "client") that are not evident from the subject. If the signal is weak or ambiguous, set protected=false and confidence below 0.5. Protect only on a clear signal — a low-confidence protection will be ignored and the event will fall through to the normal action logic.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: {"protected":true,"label":"relationship_career","confidence":0.8,"reason":"Short human-readable justification for protecting (or not protecting) this event."}

messageValues.message:
You decide what to do with a calendar event while the user is out of office. Choose exactly one action and return json with keys action, confidence (0..1) and reason.

Allowed actions:
- "cancel": the user ORGANIZES the meeting and there are attendees. Cancelling notifies everyone and removes it for all.
- "decline": the user was INVITED (not organizer) and a response is requested. Declines with a note, meeting stays for others.
- "delete": the user was invited, no response is expected/possible, but the entry should be removed from the user's own calendar only.
- "keep": leave the event untouched. Use this as the SAFE fallback whenever you are unsure, when the event looks important to keep informed on (e.g. very large meetings, all-hands, town halls where the user is one of many), or when none of the other actions clearly fit.

Prefer "keep" over guessing. Set confidence below 0.5 when uncertain; a low-confidence result will be treated as keep.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: {"action":"cancel","confidence":0.9,"reason":"Short human-readable justification for the chosen action."}
